name: ai-branch
title: AI Branch
description: React AI component: branch for conversational and agentic UIs.

files.content:
import * as React from "react" import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, GitBranch } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" export interface BranchProps extends React.HTMLAttributes { currentBranch: number totalBranches: number onPrevious: () => void onNext: () => void } export function Branch({ currentBranch, totalBranches, onPrevious, onNext, className, ...props }: BranchProps) { if (totalBranches <= 1) return null return (
{currentBranch} / {totalBranches}
) }
